Prototype 7 encodes REM (100% pure) primarily through EOG (67%), with EEG (25%) and EMG (9%) contribution.
Its EEG signature shows suppressed α (-3.8 dB, sensitivity=1.2) and elevated β_h (+6.4 dB, sensitivity=0.8).
The α activity is present in 0% of each epoch (transient), with quiescent eye movements (REM 0% active) and atonic muscle tone.
This is partially coherent with REM physiology: confirmed: EOG dominant, EMG atonic; missing: θ elevated.
